projectTitle: TWO EcN, ONE METABOLIC MISSION - A Probiotic Synergistic Therapy for the Rare Disease Hyperlysinemia
projectTitle_zh: TWO EcN, ONE METABOLIC MISSION — 以益生菌協同療法治療罕見疾病高離胺酸血症
tagline: A dual-strain E. coli Nissle 1917 consortium, physically stapled together with SpyTag/SpyCatcher, that degrades dietary lysine in the gut so hyperlysinemia patients can escape lifelong diet restriction.
tagline_zh: 一組以 SpyTag/SpyCatcher 實體釘接在一起的雙菌株 E. coli Nissle 1917 群落，在腸道中分解飲食來源的離胺酸，讓高離胺酸血症患者得以擺脫終身飲食限制。
summary: HFI (International Department, The Affiliated High School of South China Normal University, Guangzhou) built an orally delivered live biotherapeutic for hyperlysinemia, a rare AASS-mutation disorder with no approved therapy and an incidence near 1 in 411,000. They split the human saccharopine pathway across two EcN populations - an upstream strain expressing LKR and SDH, a downstream strain expressing ALDH and AASDHPPT - knocked out the endogenous ldcC lysine decarboxylase by CRISPR-Cas9 to remove background lysine consumption, and covalently coupled the two strains using eCPX-displayed SpyTag/SpyCatcher so intermediates pass between cells over a short diffusion distance. Biosafety is handled by a dual-input kill switch where an arabinose-driven Bxb1 serine integrase inverts the lysis-E cassette and an oxygen-sensing PcyoA promoter only fires outside the anaerobic gut. The project won because the dry lab genuinely steered the wet lab (NetLogo screening picked the RBS before cloning), the part collection was fully characterised with HPLC-MS, and the education and IHP programmes were unusually systematic for a high school team.
summary_zh: HFI（廣州華南師範大學附屬中學國際部）為高離胺酸血症打造了一款口服的活體生物療法；這是一種由 AASS 突變造成的罕見疾病，目前沒有核准療法，發生率約為 1/411,000。他們把人體的 saccharopine 代謝路徑拆分到兩群 EcN 上——上游菌株表現 LKR 與 SDH，下游菌株表現 ALDH 與 AASDHPPT——並以 CRISPR-Cas9 剔除內源的 ldcC 離胺酸脫羧酶，以消除背景的離胺酸消耗；再以 eCPX 展示的 SpyTag/SpyCatcher 把兩個菌株以共價方式耦合起來，使中間產物在很短的擴散距離內於細胞間傳遞。生物安全由一個雙輸入致死開關處理：由阿拉伯糖驅動的 Bxb1 絲胺酸整合酶會把 lysis-E 卡匣反轉，而感測氧氣的 PcyoA 啟動子只有在離開厭氧的腸道環境後才會啟動。此專題之所以勝出，是因為乾實驗確實引導了濕實驗（NetLogo 篩選在選殖之前就選定了 RBS）、元件集合以 HPLC-MS 做了完整特性分析，而教育與 IHP 的規劃對一支高中隊伍而言異常地系統化。
awards: Best Village Project winner (Infectious Diseases / Therapeutics / Diagnostics / Oncology)

dry.frameworks: Two complementary models, both used to make decisions rather than decorate the wiki. First, an agent-based stochastic contact model in NetLogo 3D 7.0.4: 200 cells (100 SpyTag type A, 100 SpyCatcher type B) random-walk in a periodic box spanning -16 to 16 units, diffusion speed 0.17 per tick, interaction radius 1.4, 2,000 ticks; each successful A-B contact creates an undirected graph edge, decrements both cells' remaining binding capacity, and merges cluster IDs, so a bacterial aggregate is literally a connected component of a graph. They swept seven RBS parts (B0032, B0033, B0035, B0029, B0031, B0030, B0034) mapped to 5-100 surface display sites and tracked mean cluster size, max cluster size and the full size distribution, expanding the noisy 30-site condition to 60 replicate runs to characterise its stochastic variance (max 109.6 +/- 34.5). Second, a mass-conserving 13-state-variable compartmental ODE simulator of the lysine cascade: metabolites L (lysine), S (saccharopine), A (AASA) and P (AAA) across three compartments (extracellular medium, upstream SpyCatcher cytoplasm, downstream SpyTag cytoplasm), Michaelis-Menten rate laws with half-saturation 0.2, a saturating contact signal H = B/(0.05+B) converting occupied binding capacity into extra inter-strain exchange conductance g_CT, integrated with fourth-order Runge-Kutta at base step 0.001 (reported backbone mass-balance error ~3.77e-15), with toxic AASA exposure summarised by trapezoidal AUC.
dry.frameworks_zh: 兩個互補的模型，都是用來做決策、而不是裝點 wiki。第一個是在 NetLogo 3D 7.0.4 中建的代理人隨機接觸模型：200 個細胞（100 個 SpyTag 的 A 型、100 個 SpyCatcher 的 B 型）在 -16 到 16 單位的週期性邊界盒中隨機漫步，擴散速度為每 tick 0.17，交互作用半徑 1.4，共 2,000 個 tick；每一次成功的 A-B 接觸就建立一條無向圖的邊、把兩個細胞剩餘的結合容量各減一，並合併群集 ID，因此一個細菌聚集體實際上就是圖上的一個連通分量。他們掃過七個 RBS 元件（B0032、B0033、B0035、B0029、B0031、B0030、B0034），對應到 5 到 100 個表面展示位點，並追蹤平均群集大小、最大群集大小與完整的大小分布，其中把雜訊較大的 30 位點條件擴充到 60 次重複執行，以描述其隨機變異（最大值 109.6 +/- 34.5）。第二個是一個質量守恆、含 13 個狀態變數的隔室 ODE 模擬器，描述離胺酸的串聯反應：代謝物 L（離胺酸）、S（saccharopine）、A（AASA）與 P（AAA），分布在三個隔室（胞外培養基、上游 SpyCatcher 的細胞質、下游 SpyTag 的細胞質）；採 Michaelis-Menten 速率式、半飽和常數 0.2，並以一個飽和式的接觸訊號 H = B/(0.05+B) 把已佔用的結合容量轉換為額外的跨菌株交換傳導 g_CT，以四階 Runge-Kutta 積分、基礎步長 0.001（報告的骨幹質量平衡誤差約 3.77e-15），並以梯形法 AUC 彙總具毒性的 AASA 暴露量。
dry.dataviz: Both models were ported to interactive browser pages embedded in the wiki, so a judge or reader can move the sliders and re-run the simulation live with no local install: the ODE metabolic simulator at https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/metabolism.html and the NetLogo cluster model at https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/netlogo.html. Outputs are dynamic cluster visualisations, metabolite time-course curves and quantitative readouts. Alongside this they reported the full cluster-size distribution (not just means), particle-weighted versus number-weighted distributions, and a table pairing each RBS part number with its translational strength tier and simulated outcome, which makes the in-silico screen auditable.
dry.dataviz_zh: 兩個模型都移植成內嵌於 wiki 的互動網頁，使評審或讀者不必在本機安裝任何東西就能拉動滑桿、即時重跑模擬：ODE 代謝模擬器在 https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/metabolism.html ，NetLogo 群集模型在 https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/netlogo.html 。輸出為動態的群集視覺化、代謝物時間曲線與定量讀數。除此之外，他們報告了完整的群集大小分布（不只是平均值）、以顆粒加權與以數量加權的分布對照，以及一張把每個 RBS 元件編號與其轉譯強度等級、模擬結果並列的表格，使這次電腦篩選可供查核。
dry.datascience: The dry lab was used specifically to fill a measurement gap: they could not quantify the short-lived intermediates saccharopine and AASA in the wet lab, so the ODE model predicted them and exposed an explicit design trade-off - at SC:ST 2:1 lysine clearance is fastest (residual lysine 0.0519) but AASA peaks highest (0.3767, AUC 10.43), while at 1:2 AASA stays low (peak 0.1123, AUC 3.14) but 0.2980 lysine is left unconsumed. That framing (two goals that cannot be maximised at once) drove the choice of co-culture ratios actually tested. The cluster model's prediction that moderate display (B0035, 15 sites, mean max cluster 48.67 cells, about 24% of the system) sits in the usable middle regime while 50+ sites collapses 91-98% of cells into one giant component was then checked at the bench by fluorescence microscopy with ImageJ quantification of red-green overlapping cluster count and core area (3 clusters/field at 2:1 rising to 16 at 1:1 and 14 at 1:2, mean core area 15.04 to 19.41 um2), and the simulated ratio ranking matched the HPLC lysine-removal ranking. Measurement side: a cheap ninhydrin colorimetric screen was calibrated against FDAA-derivatised HPLC-MS (lysine derivative at 17.04 min, m/z 398.1, calibration R2 = 0.9985).
dry.datascience_zh: 乾實驗被明確用來填補量測上的缺口：他們在濕實驗中無法定量短命的中間產物 saccharopine 與 AASA，於是用 ODE 模型預測，並藉此揭露一個明確的設計取捨——在 SC:ST 為 2:1 時離胺酸清除最快（殘餘離胺酸 0.0519），但 AASA 的峰值也最高（0.3767，AUC 10.43）；而在 1:2 時 AASA 維持在低位（峰值 0.1123，AUC 3.14），卻有 0.2980 的離胺酸未被消耗。這種「兩個目標無法同時最大化」的框架，決定了實際測試的共培養比例。群集模型預測中等展示量（B0035、15 個位點，最大群集平均 48.67 個細胞，約為整個系統的 24%）落在可用的中間區域，而 50 個位點以上則會讓 91-98% 的細胞塌縮成單一巨大連通分量；這項預測接著在實驗檯上以螢光顯微鏡檢驗，並用 ImageJ 定量紅綠重疊的群集數與核心面積（2:1 時每視野 3 個群集，1:1 升至 16 個、1:2 為 14 個，核心面積平均 15.04 至 19.41 um2），模擬得到的比例排序與 HPLC 測得的離胺酸移除排序一致。量測方面：以 FDAA 衍生化的 HPLC-MS 校正了一套便宜的 ninhydrin 比色篩檢（離胺酸衍生物滯留時間 17.04 分鐘、m/z 398.1，校正曲線 R2 = 0.9985）。
dry.software: No standalone software tool was released, but the two models are published as free-standing interactive web pages inside the wiki (metabolism.html and netlogo.html) and the complete NetLogo source (setup, go, update-cluster-distribution, avg-cluster-size, max-cluster-size, sweep-rbs, scan-catcher-series procedures) is printed in full on the Model page so another team can rerun the screen. Repository: https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/hfi. They also contributed a documented part collection to the Registry including BBa_26S7HLMM (ldcC target sequence) and BBa_269KMPAL (pEcgRNA-ldcC), plus the two models listed as community contributions.
dry.software_zh: 沒有釋出獨立的軟體工具，但兩個模型以可獨立運作的互動網頁發布在 wiki 內（metabolism.html 與 netlogo.html），而完整的 NetLogo 原始碼（setup、go、update-cluster-distribution、avg-cluster-size、max-cluster-size、sweep-rbs、scan-catcher-series 等程序）則完整印在 Model 頁上，讓其他隊伍可以重跑這次篩選。程式庫：https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/hfi 。他們也向 Registry 貢獻了一組有完整文件的元件集合，包括 BBa_26S7HLMM（ldcC 標的序列）與 BBa_269KMPAL（pEcgRNA-ldcC），另有兩個模型列為社群貢獻。
techniques: in-silico RBS strength screening before cloning
replicate-expanded stochastic variance characterisation (n=60 at the unstable condition)
strain-ratio flux trade-off analysis (AASA peak vs AUC vs residual lysine)
model-to-bench validation by fluorescence microscopy + ImageJ
mass-balance error reporting as a numerical sanity check

good.publicEngagement: Education was designed from survey data rather than guesswork, and ran on an explicit five-step cycle they named CLEAR (Connect, Layer, Engage, Assess, Reinforce) in which every activity had to report a measured outcome and a change for the next iteration. Highlights: a self-written microbiology comic book issued in Cantonese and Mandarin dialect versions, with English, Japanese and German recorded audiobooks and text versions in Arabic, German, Russian, French, Korean, Portuguese, Japanese, Thai, Spanish and Indonesian - explicitly supplied as text so local educators can generate their own AI text-to-speech audio in languages the team does not speak. They ran a 100+ student conference at HFI International, a HFI Academic Summit with hands-on fruit DNA extraction, recorded lab-technique video lessons (pipetting, agarose gel electrophoresis, clean bench, plus an SMA rare-disease case study) on iGEM Video and Bilibili, an online Q&A session on Tencent Meeting, a university biology major exhibition poster, a Gobi Desert biology trip, a synthetic biology student society, outreach at the Guangzhou Social Welfare Institute, and a professional session with HSBC on financial literacy. Impact was measured with paired pre/post surveys: at the Academic Summit (n=24) correct identification of synthetic biology rose 79% to 96% with the 'synthetic biology is another name for genetic testing' misconception falling 8% to 0%, and correct understanding that DNA is in every living cell including fruit cells rose 42% to 88%. They also tracked platform metrics honestly, noting that 15 WeChat posts drew 248 likes, 955 views, 63 shares and zero comments, concluding one-way delivery was failing and pivoting to interactive formats, after which video lessons drew comments for the first time.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 教育工作是依問卷資料設計、而非憑猜測，並依他們命名為 CLEAR（Connect、Layer、Engage、Assess、Reinforce）的明確五步循環運作，其中每項活動都必須回報一項可量測的結果與下一輪的一項改動。亮點包括：一本自行創作的微生物學漫畫，發行粵語與國語方言版本，並錄製英語、日語與德語有聲書，另提供阿拉伯語、德語、俄語、法語、韓語、葡萄牙語、日語、泰語、西班牙語與印尼語的文字版——文字版是刻意提供的，讓各地教育者能用 AI 文字轉語音自行生成團隊成員不會說的語言的音檔。他們在 HFI 國際部辦了一場 100 人以上的學生會議、一場包含動手做水果 DNA 萃取的 HFI 學術高峰會，在 iGEM Video 與 Bilibili 上發布實驗技術影片課程（吸量操作、瓊膠電泳、無菌操作檯，另有一則 SMA 罕病案例研究），在騰訊會議上辦線上問答，在大學生物科系展覽張貼海報，辦了一趟戈壁沙漠生物考察，成立了合成生物學學生社團，到廣州市社會福利院做科普，並與匯豐銀行合辦一場金融素養的專業講座。成效以前後配對問卷量測：在學術高峰會（n=24）中，能正確辨識合成生物學的比例從 79% 升至 96%，「合成生物學只是基因檢測的另一個說法」這個迷思從 8% 降到 0%，而正確理解 DNA 存在於每個活細胞、包括水果細胞中的比例從 42% 升至 88%。他們也誠實追蹤平台數據，指出 15 篇微信貼文獲得 248 個讚、955 次瀏覽、63 次分享與零則留言，由此判斷單向傳遞行不通，轉而採用互動形式，之後影片課程才首次出現留言。
good.ihp: IHP ran through a named six-step cycle (LYSERA: Listen, Yield, Shape, Execute, Reflect, Apply) across six sequenced phases - stakeholder mapping on an interest/power matrix, a 434-response public survey, technical validation, clinical and patient engagement, commercial and regulatory consultation, and peer review - then looped back through phases 3 to 6 a second time. The changes are concrete. Dr. Mingjun Sun (Sichuan University, synthetic biology and AI protein design) argued the lag between lysine detection and enzyme expression would make the probiotics miss the postprandial treatment window, so HFI abandoned the lysine-responsive promoter entirely and switched to constitutive expression of all degradation enzymes; he also warned that SpyTag/SpyCatcher aggregation risk scales with expression level and suggested building a computational model instead of trial and error, which is the direct origin of the NetLogo cluster model and the choice of medium-to-low strength RBS. Professor Liujie Huo questioned whether intestinal lysine concentration tracks blood lysine at all, forcing them to re-examine the physiological basis and repositioning of the product. The public survey changed the language of every outreach material: 'genetically modified' was replaced with 'engineered' across all materials because the survey showed the former triggered unease, and because 76.04% of respondents had heard of rare diseases but could not name one while only 8.29% could name three, education was rebuilt to start from absolute basics. Survey findings that 56.22% supported national insurance coverage and 59.45% preferred prescription-drug regulation validated the hospital-first go-to-market route and tiered pricing. Mr. Guodong Huo of the Illness Challenge Foundation insisted patients are not defined by their condition, which set a non-stigmatising language policy and a no-false-hope rule for all materials. Safety feedback (protease degradation risk) added simulated intestinal fluid stability tests to the experimental plan.
good.ihp_zh: IHP 以一個命名過的六步循環（LYSERA：Listen、Yield、Shape、Execute、Reflect、Apply）貫穿六個依序推進的階段——以興趣／影響力矩陣繪製利害關係人地圖、一份 434 份回覆的公眾問卷、技術驗證、臨床與病友端接觸、商業與法規諮詢，以及同儕審閱——之後再把第 3 到第 6 階段跑過第二輪。改動相當具體。四川大學的孫明軍博士（合成生物學與 AI 蛋白質設計）指出，從偵測到離胺酸到酵素表現之間的時間落差會讓益生菌錯過餐後的治療窗口，於是 HFI 徹底放棄了對離胺酸有反應的啟動子，改為讓所有分解酵素都以組成型表現；他也警告 SpyTag/SpyCatcher 的聚集風險會隨表現量上升，建議建一個運算模型、而不是靠試誤，這正是 NetLogo 群集模型與選用中低強度 RBS 的直接來源。霍丽洁教授則質疑腸道內的離胺酸濃度究竟是否與血中離胺酸連動，迫使他們重新檢視產品的生理學基礎與定位。公眾問卷改變了所有科普材料的用語：所有材料中的「基因改造」都換成了「工程改造」，因為問卷顯示前者會引發不安；又因為 76.04% 的受訪者聽過罕見疾病但說不出任何一種、只有 8.29% 能說出三種，教育內容便重建為從最基本處開始。問卷顯示 56.22% 支持納入國家醫保、59.45% 偏好以處方藥方式管理，這佐證了先走醫院的上市路徑與分級定價。病痛挑戰基金會的霍国东先生強調病人不該被其疾病定義，這確立了所有材料的非汙名化用語政策與「不給假希望」原則。安全性方面的意見（蛋白酶降解風險）則讓實驗計畫加上了模擬腸液的穩定性測試。
good.realWorld: A full commercial dossier for EcN-BioShield covering unmet need, TAM/SAM/SOM, PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, SWOT, competitor analysis against lysine-free medical foods such as Hyper LYS Anamix Infant (UK NHS ~GBP 54 per 400 g can, roughly GBP 1,500-2,000/year), a Business Model Canvas, and a 20-year financial projection. Pricing was set at 2,000 CNY per 30-capsule bottle (24,000 CNY per patient-year) after stakeholder consultation on affordability, with a modelled initial funding requirement of 1,260,000 CNY, break-even in year 16.79 and cumulative payoff of 59,020,546 CNY by year 20 - unusually long-horizon honesty for a student plan. They mapped three regulatory routes in parallel because hyperlysinemia is not in China's Rare Disease Catalog and there is no settled Live Biotherapeutic Product registration pathway, including applying to NMPA's Center for Drug Evaluation for Orphan Drug Designation. Risk management is broken out by regulatory, clinical, commercial, technical, public-acceptance, competitive and financial risk, with an early/mid/long-term (1-5, 5-10, 11+ year) milestone timeline. Ethical commitments include tiered pricing plus advocacy for national insurance coverage, no overstatement of readiness, age-appropriate formulations, and patient-data confidentiality.
good.realWorld_zh: EcN-BioShield 有一份完整的商業文件，涵蓋未滿足需求、TAM/SAM/SOM、PESTEL、波特五力、SWOT，以及對照無離胺酸醫療食品（如 Hyper LYS Anamix Infant，英國 NHS 每 400 g 罐約 54 英鎊，約每年 1,500-2,000 英鎊）的競爭分析，另有商業模式畫布與一份 20 年財務預測。價格在就可負擔性諮詢利害關係人後，訂為每瓶 30 顆膠囊 2,000 人民幣（每位患者每年 24,000 人民幣），模型推算初始資金需求為 1,260,000 人民幣，於第 16.79 年損益兩平，到第 20 年累積回報 59,020,546 人民幣——對一份學生計畫而言，這種長期視野的誠實相當罕見。他們並行規劃了三條法規路徑，因為高離胺酸血症並未列入中國的罕見病目錄，而活體生物治療產品也沒有定案的註冊途徑，其中包括向 NMPA 藥品審評中心申請孤兒藥資格。風險管理依法規、臨床、商業、技術、公眾接受度、競爭與財務分別拆開，並附一條短／中／長期（1-5、5-10、11 年以上）的里程碑時程。倫理承諾包括分級定價並同時倡議納入國家醫保、不誇大技術成熟度、提供符合各年齡層的劑型，以及病人資料保密。

gemsTakeaway: Copy HFI's habit of making the dry lab a gatekeeper for the wet lab: a free NetLogo agent-based model screened seven candidate RBS parts and picked B0035 before a single plasmid was built, and an ODE model predicted the intermediates the team physically could not measure - both then republished as live browser sliders so a reader can rerun them. The second transferable move is their CLEAR/LYSERA discipline of refusing to log any outreach or stakeholder meeting unless it produced a measured outcome (paired pre/post surveys, engagement metrics including the embarrassing zero-comment result) and a named change in the next iteration.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 值得借鏡的是 HFI 讓乾實驗擔任濕實驗守門人的習慣：一個免費的 NetLogo 代理人模型篩過七個候選 RBS 元件、在一個質體都還沒做出來之前就選定了 B0035，而一個 ODE 模型則預測了團隊實際上量不到的中間產物——兩者之後都以可在瀏覽器即時操作的滑桿重新發布，讓讀者能自己重跑。第二項可移植的做法是他們 CLEAR／LYSERA 的紀律：任何科普活動或利害關係人會面，若沒有產出可量測的結果（前後配對問卷、互動數據，包括那個令人難為情的零留言結果）以及下一輪具名的改動，就不予登錄。
